May 24, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Beeneet Kothari increased its stake in Stamps Com Inc (STMP) by 13.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tekne Capital Management Llc bought 21,709 shares as the company’s stock rose 7.45% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Beeneet Kothari held 183,773 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.55 million, up from 162,064 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tekne Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Stamps Com Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.45 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.81% or $2 during the last trading session, reaching $248.15. About 185,631 shares traded. Stamps.com Inc. (NASDAQ:STMP) has risen 69.91% since May 24, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 58.36% the S&P500.
